intent: The alert's own headline - a short label for what the alert is about.
typical_uses: The first line inside an Alert, naming the message before its longer description

dont_use_when.situation: A heading anywhere outside of an Alert

instead.target: a plain heading element, sized for its own surrounding context
instead.note: AlertTitle carries Alert's own typography and the icon-column layout hook; this kit has no generic standalone heading component to substitute.

invariants.text: When the enclosing Alert has a direct <svg> child, AlertTitle is the part pushed into the icon layout's second column; AlertDescription is not, because grid auto-placement already skips the icon's row-spanning cell for it.

anti_patterns.dont: Put the alert's leading icon inside AlertTitle
anti_patterns.do_instead: Render the <svg> as a direct child of Alert, before AlertTitle - the icon layout is detected off Alert's direct <svg> children, not AlertTitle's

good.title: A short headline above the alert's description
good.code:
<Alert>
  <AlertTitle>Update available</AlertTitle>
  <AlertDescription>A new version is ready to install.</AlertDescription>
</Alert>

bad.title: Leading icon nested inside AlertTitle
bad.why: The icon layout is detected off Alert's direct <svg> children, not AlertTitle's; an icon nested here renders inline with the heading text instead of switching to the icon column.
